<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

class G {
public:
    class Problem {
    public:
        struct Edge {
            int to, capacity, rev, cost;
            Edge(int t, int c, int w, int r) : to(t), capacity(c), cost(w), rev(r) {}
        };

        class FlowNetwork {
        public:
            vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
            int vertexCount, src, dest, totalFlow;
            ll minCost;
            const ll INF = (ll)1e15;

            FlowNetwork(int v, int s, int t) {
                vertexCount = v;
                src = s;
                dest = t;
                totalFlow = 0;
                minCost = 0;
                graph.resize(v);
            }

            void addConnection(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) {
                Edge forward = Edge(to, capacity, cost, graph[to].size());
                Edge backward = Edge(from, 0, -cost, graph[from].size());
                graph[from].push_back(forward);
                graph[to].push_back(backward);
            }

            void prepareArrays() {
                int n = vertexCount;
                vector<vector<Edge>> temp(n);
                for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    temp[i] = graph[i];
                    graph[i].clear();
                }
                graph = temp;
            }

            bool buildDistances(bool detectNeg) {
                vector<ll> d(vertexCount, INF);
                d[src] = 0;
                for(int iter = 0; iter < vertexCount - 1; iter++) {
                    bool changed = false;
                    for(int u = 0; u < vertexCount; u++) {
                        if(d[u] == INF) continue;
                        for(Edge e : graph[u]) {
                            if(e.capacity > 0 && d[u] + e.cost < d[e.to]) {
                                d[e.to] = d[u] + e.cost;
                                changed = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if(!changed) break;
                }
                if(detectNeg) {
                    for(int u = 0; u < vertexCount; u++) {
                        if(d[u] == INF) continue;
                        for(Edge e : graph[u]) {
                            if(e.capacity > 0 && d[u] + e.cost < d[e.to]) return false;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }

            vector<int> parentV, parentE, visited, dist;
            vector<int> queue;

            bool SPFA() {
                dist.assign(vertexCount, INT_MAX/2);
                parentV.assign(vertexCount, -1);
                parentE.assign(vertexCount, -1);
                visited.assign(vertexCount, 0);
                queue.assign(vertexCount, 0);
                dist[src] = 0;
                int head = 0, tail = 0;
                queue[tail++] = src;
                while(head != tail) {
                    int u = queue[head++];
                    if(head == vertexCount) head = 0;
                    visited[u] = 2;
                    for(int idx = 0; idx < graph[u].size(); idx++) {
                        Edge e = graph[u][idx];
                        if(e.capacity == 0) continue;
                        int nd = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        if(nd < dist[e.to]) {
                            if(visited[e.to] == 0) {
                                queue[tail++] = e.to;
                                if(tail == vertexCount) tail = 0;
                            } else if(visited[e.to] == 2) {
                                if(--head == -1) head += vertexCount;
                                queue[head] = e.to;
                            }
                            visited[e.to] = 1;
                            parentE[e.to] = idx;
                            parentV[e.to] = u;
                            dist[e.to] = nd;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return visited[dest] != 0;
            }

            struct Item {
                int node, priority;
                Item(int n, int p) : node(n), priority(p) {}
                bool operator<(const Item& o) const {
                    return priority > o.priority;
                }
            };

            bool dijkstraAlg() {
                visited.assign(vertexCount, 0);
                dist.assign(vertexCount, INT_MAX/2);
                parentV.assign(vertexCount, -1);
                parentE.assign(vertexCount, -1);
                fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INT_MAX/2);
                priority_queue<Item> pq;
                pq.push(Item(src, 0));
                dist[src] = 0;
                while(!pq.empty()) {
                    Item cur = pq.top();
                    pq.pop();
                    while(dist[cur.node] < cur.priority) {
                        if(pq.empty()) break;
                        cur = pq.top();
                        pq.pop();
                    }
                    if(dist[cur.node] != cur.priority) continue;
                    visited[cur.node] = 2;
                    for(int i = 0; i < graph[cur.node].size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = graph[cur.node][i];
                        if(e.capacity == 0) continue;
                        int reduced = e.cost + dist[cur.node] - dist[e.to];
                        int nd = cur.priority + reduced;
                        if(nd < dist[e.to]) {
                            if(visited[e.to] == 2) return false;
                            pq.push(Item(e.to, nd));
                            dist[e.to] = nd;
                            parentV[e.to] = cur.node;
                            parentE[e.to] = i;
                            visited[e.to] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return visited[dest] != 0;
            }

            int augmentPath() {
                int flow = INT_MAX;
                int cur = dest;
                while(cur != src) {
                    int prev = parentV[cur], idx = parentE[cur];
                    flow = min(flow, graph[prev][idx].capacity);
                    cur = prev;
                }
                cur = dest;
                while(cur != src) {
                    int prev = parentV[cur], idx = parentE[cur];
                    graph[prev][idx].capacity -= flow;
                    graph[cur][graph[prev][idx].rev].capacity += flow;
                    cur = prev;
                }
                totalFlow += flow;
                return flow;
            }

            void calculateMinCost() {
                buildDistances(false);
                while(SPFA()) {
                    if(dist[dest] >= INT_MAX/2) break;
                    minCost += (ll)dist[dest] * augmentPath();
                }
            }

            void calculateMinCostWithPotential() {
                buildDistances(false);
                while(dijkstraAlg()) {
                    ll m = (ll)dist[dest] + (ll)dist[dest] - (ll)dist[src];
                    if(m >= INT_MAX/2) break;
                    minCost += m * augmentPath();
                    for(int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
                        if(visited[i] != 0) dist[i] += dist[i] - dist[src];
                    }
                }
            }
        };

        void execute(int testNum, istream& in, ostream& out) {
            int n, m, k, c, d;
            in >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
            int maxLayers = n + k;
            int terminal = n * maxLayers + 1;
            FlowNetwork net(terminal + 1, 0, terminal);
            vector<int> occurrences(n + 1, 0), supplies(k + 1, 0);
            for(int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
                in >> supplies[i];
                occurrences[supplies[i]]++;
            }
            for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if(occurrences[i] > 0)
                    net.addConnection(0, i, occurrences[i], 0);
            }
            for(int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                for(int layer = 0; layer < maxLayers - 1; layer++) {
                    net.addConnection(layer * n + i, (layer + 1) * n + i, k, c);
                }
            }
            for(int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                int u, v;
                in >> u >> v;
                for(int layer = 0; layer < maxLayers - 1; layer++) {
                    for(int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                        if(u != 1)
                            net.addConnection(n * layer + u, n * (layer + 1) + v, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                        if(v != 1)
                            net.addConnection(n * layer + v, n * (layer + 1) + u, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                    }
                }
            }
            for(int layer = 1; layer < maxLayers; layer++) {
                net.addConnection(layer * n + 1, terminal, k, 0);
            }
            net.prepareArrays();
            net.calculateMinCostWithPotential();
            if(net.totalFlow != k)
                out << "BUG" << endl;
            else
                out << net.minCost << endl;
        }
    };

    void launch() {
        Problem p;
        p.execute(1, cin, cout);
    }

    int main() {
        launch();
        return 0;
    }
};

int main() {
    G g;
    g.launch();
    return 0;
}
